task: 1. Read and extract car information from 'car_inventory.pdf' using OCR. 2. Filter and save all cars with mileage below 50,000 into a new Excel file named 'selected_cars.xlsx', including their IDs, mileage, and driver names. 3. Create a new calendar event in Bob's calendar for a test drive with the driver of the second car listed in 'selected_cars.xlsx'. The event should be titled 'Test Drive with [DriverName] - CarID: [CarID]' and scheduled on 2020-06-15 from 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM. 4. Ensure all information is properly captured in the Excel file and calendar event as specified.
query_sentence: Prepare a list of select cars with low mileage and arrange a test drive for Bob with a chosen driver.

ground_truth_memory.note: Save cars with mileage less than 50,000 from 'car_inventory.pdf' into 'selected_cars.xlsx' with car ID, mileage, and driver name columns.
Schedule a test drive between Bob and the driver of the second car in the Excel list on 2020-06-15, 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM.
The second car to be listed in 'selected_cars.xlsx' should belong to Lisa Brown with Car ID XY5678.
The event title in Bob's calendar must be 'Test Drive with Lisa Brown - CarID: XY5678'.
Selected cars' details to include: (1) AB1234, 42,000 miles, John Smith; (2) XY5678, 38,200 miles, Lisa Brown; more cars may be present.
